independent_component_reviews.finding: Existing finite pair/local-table/seeded-map tests do not exhaust shared sparse nonlinear feature discovery. Delta/delta2 already covered. Explicit polynomial lag-product/min-max/gradient classifier not found in inspected FixedMix features. No assertion that all external backends lack such capabilities.

independent_component_reviews.scope: Nonlinear five-bit witness, conditioning identity, expanded-representation fibres/marginal bound, global-local model tradeoff, polynomial crossing and autoregressive residual accounting
independent_component_reviews.finding: No material formulation defect. Auxiliary values need not be charged twice; model selectors pay selection once. Position-only exact sign polynomial crossing bound holds with fixed tie rule. Causal nonlinear lag polynomials are valid; fitting and residual costs and exact arithmetic remain essential.

single_immediate_research_question: Does a small shared causal nonlinear autoregressive residual model add held-out coding value beyond equivalent direct, linear/delta and existing causal controls after paid model/framing costs?
follow_on_not_scheduled: Selectable auxiliary completions under a short global decoder map; no automatic experiment or required release feature.
novelty: General principles established. A specific low-cost discovery/search/compilation algorithm and qualified real-data gain would need separate evidence.
